name: ai-telephony-demo
description: Build an AI Telephony Agent for Inbound and Outbound Calls
readme_summary: This repository allows you to build and deploy a fully functional AI telephony agent. It guides you through setting up an agent locally and configuring it to handle live inbound and outbound phone calls using VideoSDK and Google's Gemini model.
key_features: Utilizes Google Gemini for AI capabilities
primary_use_case: To enable developers to create and deploy AI-powered voice agents capable of interacting over traditional phone lines.
cover_image_prompt: A friendly, stylized robot assistant wearing a headset, standing at a futuristic switchboard. One hand is holding a glowing microphone, representing voice input, and the other is gesturing towards a holographic display showing a phone call interface with flowing data streams. Subtle visual cues like small, abstract sound waves and digital particles connect the robot to the phone network. The background is a clean, modern server room with soft, ambient lighting. The overall mood is helpful and innovative. The image should be in a 3D isometric illustration style, with a focus on clarity and a bright, approachable color palette, clearly depicting the AI agent facilitating phone communication.

name: VeraCrypt
description: Disk encryption with strong security based on TrueCrypt
readme_summary: VeraCrypt is an open-source disk encryption software based on TrueCrypt, offering enhanced security features. It allows users to create encrypted volumes, partitions, or entire system drives to protect sensitive data from unauthorized access.
key_features: Support for various encryption algorithms (AES, Serpent, Twofish)
primary_use_case: Protecting sensitive data on storage devices through robust encryption.
cover_image_prompt: A medieval castle with a shimmering, impenetrable force field protecting its treasure vault. Inside the vault, gold coins and jewels are visible, but they are encased in glowing, transparent digital cubes. Guards patrol the castle walls, holding glowing shields that display complex encryption algorithms. Small, stylized data streams flow into the force field, representing secure data input. The overall mood is one of robust security and impenetrable protection. The art style should be a detailed 3D isometric illustration with a dark, secure color palette, emphasizing the strength and digital nature of the encryption.

name: awesome-django
description: A curated list of awesome things related to Django
readme_summary: Awesome Django is a curated list of resources and third-party packages for the Django web framework. It serves as a comprehensive guide for developers looking to enhance their Django projects with various tools and libraries.
key_features: Includes official resources, educational materials, community links, and hosting options
Dedicated sections for Django REST Framework and Wagtail CMS
primary_use_case: To provide a centralized and organized collection of high-quality resources and tools for Django developers.
cover_image_prompt: A vibrant, stylized illustration of a master craftsman meticulously assembling a complex, beautiful clockwork mechanism. Gears, springs, and intricate components represent various Django packages and tools. Some components are glowing with a soft light, indicating their usefulness. The craftsman holds a blueprint labeled 'Django' and uses specialized tools that subtly resemble code snippets. The background is a clean, modern workshop with shelves filled with organized books and digital displays showing elegant code structures. The overall mood is one of precision, creativity, and comprehensive support for building sophisticated web applications. 3D isometric illustration style with a bright, inviting color palette.

name: CyberScraper-2077
description: A Powerful web scraper powered by LLM | OpenAI, Gemini & Ollama
readme_summary: CyberScraper 2077 is an AI-powered web scraping tool that leverages LLMs like OpenAI, Gemini, and Ollama to intelligently extract data from websites. It features a user-friendly Streamlit interface, supports multiple export formats, and includes advanced features like Tor network access, stealth mode, and captcha bypassing.
key_features: Multi-Format Support (JSON, CSV, HTML, SQL, Excel)
primary_use_case: Intelligent and advanced web scraping with AI assistance for precise data extraction.
cover_image_prompt: A futuristic netrunner, depicted as a skilled artisan, is meticulously extracting glowing threads of data from a complex, holographic web structure. The netrunner uses a sleek, futuristic interface projected from their cybernetic arm, with small screens showing AI model icons (OpenAI, Gemini, Ollama) and data snippets. The extracted data threads are being neatly organized into distinct, labeled containers representing various file formats (JSON, CSV, Excel). The background is a dimly lit, cyberpunk city street at night, with neon signs reflecting on wet pavement. The overall mood is one of sophisticated data extraction and technological prowess, rendered in a 3D isometric illustration style with vibrant neon accents and a dark, atmospheric color palette.
